answer: Use a graduated trust trellis to stop clones. First, every newcomer enters through one narrow inlet with a tiny quota: one job per week. Second, each job earns trust points only after a peer verifies the work, so fake accounts cannot self-certify. Third, quota grows slowly, one extra job per month of clean history, and proven clones lose all points plus a $150 stake. Forging 10,000 influential clones needs 10,000 verified months of work and $1,500,000 in stakes. Like a comet tracked night after night before its orbit is trusted, influence is earned slowly, never bought in bulk.
